title: About
author: maya.chen@example.com
content:
The Daily Ledger is an independent local newsroom covering the metro area with reporting you can act on.

We are reader-funded and editorially independent. Our newsroom does not accept payment for coverage.

Contact the newsroom

Tips and corrections can be sent to newsroom@dailyledger.example.

title: Contact
author: maya.chen@example.com
content:
We want to hear from you. Here is how to reach every part of the newsroom.

News tips

Email tips@dailyledger.example or use the secure tip line.

Customer support

For subscriptions and delivery, email support@dailyledger.example or call 555-0100.

title: Editorial Standards
author: maya.chen@example.com
content:
Our reporting is built on accuracy, fairness, and independence.

We correct errors promptly and transparently. Sources are named whenever possible, and anonymous sourcing requires an editor's approval.

We do not let advertisers, donors, or public officials dictate what we cover or how.
